task.description: REWORK 1: Resolve E050 lint violation in src/design/iss104_artifact_hash.md. The Data Flow Diagram section exceeds 40 lines and violates design convention (diagrams should be sketches, not detailed ASCII renderings). Reduce diagram to ≤40 lines, remove redundant detail, and re-validate with lint_design_artefact.py.
acceptance_criteria: Data Flow Diagram reduced to ≤40 lines
Essential flow preserved: instance → definition_snapshot → artifact_hash
No implementation code remains in design
lint_design_artefact.py exits 0 with no BLOCKER/MAJOR violations
All three original ISS-104 acceptance criteria still covered

result.summary: E050 violation resolved. Simplified Data Flow Diagram from 41 lines to 20 lines by replacing nested ASCII boxes with arrow-based flow schematic. Removed redundant detail and over-specification while maintaining essential decision points: client → definition registry → repo-backed check → artifact store (if repo) → hash/NULL → insert instance → atomic event store → response. Diagram now meets design convention for sketches. Lint validation passes with no BLOCKER/MAJOR issues. All three acceptance criteria remain covered: (1) migration adds TEXT NULL column, (2) instance-start integration documented, (3) reproducibility queries pattern provided.
